episodes.name: 'You're Dead Already'
episodes.overviewEn: In 2023, Detective Hasan discovers a dead body in Longharvest Lane, Whitechapel — while in 1941 and 1890, two other detectives find the same corpse.

episodes.name: 'Do You Know Who I Am?'
episodes.overviewEn: Hasan follows new leads in the present. As Hillinghead reluctantly closes his case, Whiteman goes to desperate lengths to hide involvement in his own.

episodes.name: 'All In Good Time'
episodes.overviewEn: Connections between the cases start to come into focus. Whiteman encounters an unexpected complication; Hillinghead attends a séance.

episodes.name: 'Right Up the Wazoo'
episodes.overviewEn: Hasan discovers she isn't the only detective investigating a murder on Longharvest Lane. In the past and future alike, relationships start to deepen.

episodes.name: 'We Are One Another's Ghosts'
episodes.overviewEn: The past, present and future collide as a set of fingerprints from 1890 are found in 2023. Maplewood uncovers the Commander's true identity.

episodes.name: 'The World Is Yours'
episodes.overviewEn: On the day of the explosion, Hasan does everything in her power to help Elias make a life-altering choice. The others wrestle with their consciences.

episodes.name: 'Catch Me If You Can'
episodes.overviewEn: Elias finally knows what it means to be loved. He creates the family he's always wanted — but Hillinghead has to suffer for it.

episodes.name: 'Know You Are Loved'
episodes.overviewEn: Across decades, the detectives work together to stop Elias from reshaping history. Will words be enough to break the loop and save thousands of lives?
